confidence_notes: Low overall. Food anchors draw on mixed, partly dated Hampi guides with inconsistent ranges. Drink prices rest on one upscale hotel menu and a north-bank bar guide; alcohol is restricted in the main bazaar, so beer and wine reflect north-bank bars and licensed hotels. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer price relationships (cocktail nearly double beer, wine about double) because direct evidence was thin. Beer assumes a standard bottled serving since draft is uncommon. Accommodation is a model estimate for a July monsoon (low) season, not checked against listings or booking pages; no accommodation searches were run. Rupee figures were converted at approximate rates, not live ones.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are Hampi-specific (north-bank bars, a Hampi hotel menu, local restaurant guides); accommodation is a general model estimate for Hampi guesthouse and hostel levels in July.
